newsitem.title: MACAU: Macau records 6.8 milion visitors in Jan-Oct, 1996.
newsitem.headline: Macau records 6.8 milion visitors in Jan-Oct, 1996.

text.p: Macau recorded more than 6.8 million visitors in the first 10 months of 1996, up 5.6 percent from the same period in 1995, the Macau Statistics and Census Department said on Sunday.
Hong Kong visitors, mostly casino gamblers, accounted for two-third of all arrivals in the Portuguese-run enclave, it said.
But the number of Hong Kong visitors fell 6.3 percent compared with 1995, while Taiwanese visitors, which accounted for nine percent of all arrivals, grew 171 percent, it said but gave no figures.
The daily average of arrivals in the first 10 months of 1996 reached 22,333, corresponding to about five percent of the local population of more than 454,000.

Macau's 41 hotels, two Portuguese-style inns and 62 guesthouses recorded 2.24 million guests, up 8.4 percent on the January-October period in 1995. The average occupancy rate rose 7.7 percentage points to 65.6 percent, it said.
